en: Black‑and‑white landscape view over a river in a steep valley. A suspension bridge with two heavy masonry towers spans the river, while farther downstream a low footbridge crosses near the water. On the right, atop a forested hill, stands a sizable medieval castle complex with thick walls and a high central keep, attached to which is a church with a tall tower and steeple. On the left bank and in the background are smaller village buildings and wooded hills. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.
